in_sanskrit.name: Saikrishna
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: SaI (Lord of) + Krishna (Krishna, the eighth avatar of Lord Vishnu)

in_hindi.name: Saikrishna
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Compassion
in_hindi.long_meaning: Saikrishna एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Lord Saikrishna is a form of Lord Vishnu who is the god of compassion. He is also known as Sai Baba, and is believed to be the protector and savior of his devotees.

in_tamil.name: Saikrishna
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் God of Compassion
in_tamil.long_meaning: Saikrishna ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Lord Saikrishna is a form of Lord Vishnu who is the god of compassion. He is also known as Sai Baba, and is believed to be the protector and savior of his devotees.

in_telugu.name: Saikrishna
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే God of Compassion
in_telugu.long_meaning: Saikrishna ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Lord Saikrishna is a form of Lord Vishnu who is the god of compassion. He is also known as Sai Baba, and is believed to be the protector and savior of his devotees.

in_marathi.name: Saikrishna
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Compassion
in_marathi.long_meaning: Saikrishna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lord Saikrishna is a form of Lord Vishnu who is the god of compassion. He is also known as Sai Baba, and is believed to be the protector and savior of his devotees.

in_bengali.name: Saikrishna
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Compassion
in_bengali.long_meaning: Saikrishna একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Lord Saikrishna is a form of Lord Vishnu who is the god of compassion. He is also known as Sai Baba, and is believed to be the protector and savior of his devotees.
